title: Quasi-Helmholtz Calderón Multiplicative Preconditioning for Higher-Order Global Multi-Trace Integral Equations
summary: The paper presents a higher-order global multi-trace integral equation for time-harmonic electromagnetic scattering by composite objects. The higher-order multi-trace formulation is preconditioned with a Calderón multiplicative preconditioner using higher-order quasi-Helmholtz projectors. The higher-order quasi-Helmholtz projectors separate the solenoidal and non-solenoidal components of the basis functions.
